Louisiana: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open Louisiana on the map

Key dates

  • Voter registration deadline (in person, by mail, or at an OMV office): October 5, 2026. The deadline to register online through GeauxVote was 2026-10-13. Both deadlines have passed.
  • Early voting: October 20, 2026 to October 27, 2026. 8:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. daily. No early voting on Sunday, October 25.
  • Last day to request an absentee (mail) ballot: October 30, 2026. Request by 4:30 p.m. Your parish Registrar of Voters must receive the voted ballot by 4:30 p.m. on 2026-11-02. Different rules apply to military and overseas voters.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open 6 a.m. to 8 p.m.

Official election information: Louisiana Secretary of State – Elections & Voting

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.
